2607.07674.title: Max Out GRPO Signal: Adaptive Trace Prefix Control for Hard Reasoning Problems
2607.07674.paper_summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) stalls on a model's hardest problems: when no rollout in a group succeeds, the group-relative advantages vanish and the problem contributes no gradient, wasting the frontier examples we most want to learn from. Prepending a correct prefix of a reference solution raises the success rate, making prefix length a continuous knob on difficulty. Concurrent methods set the knob once; AdaPrefix-GRPO turns it into a feedback controller: throughout training it adjusts how much of the solution each problem gets, holding its success rate near 50%, where GRPO's gradient signal is largest, then withdraws the assistance entirely, so the deployed model solves problems unaided. On hard math, at matched training FLOPs, it more than doubles GRPO's accuracy on held-out problems from the training distribution for a 0.6B model (2.1x), with 1.6x on Qwen3-1.7B and 1.7x on AIME, while roughly halving trace length. The method is implemented in data preparation plus a loss mask on prefix tokens; the trainer is otherwise stock. The smaller the model, the larger the gain.
2607.07674.paper_summary_zh: 群體相對政策優化（GRPO）在模型最難的問題上停滯不前：當一個群體中沒有任何一次展開成功時，群體相對優勢消失，該問題不再貢獻梯度，浪費了我們最想從中學習的前沿範例。添加一個正確的參考解決方案前綴可以提高成功率，使前綴長度成為難度的連續調節器。並行方法一次性設置這個調節器；而AdaPrefix-GRPO則將其轉變為一個反饋控制器：在整個訓練過程中，它調整每個問題獲得解決方案的比例，將成功率保持在接近50%的水平，這裡GRPO的梯度信號最大，然後完全撤回幫助，讓部署的模型獨立解決問題。在難度較大的數學問題上，在相同的訓練FLOPs下，對於0.6B模型，它在訓練分佈中保留的問題上將GRPO的準確率提高了超過兩倍（2.1倍），在Qwen3-1.7B上提高了1.6倍，在AIME上提高了1.7倍，同時大約減半了追蹤長度。該方法在數據準備中實施，並在前綴標記上使用損失掩碼；訓練器則保持原樣。模型越小，增益越大。
2607.07674.author: Vladislav Beliaev et.al.
